lines.zh: 我的脚步跨过一整个坐标。
lines.en: My stride spans a whole coordinate.

lines.zh: 我在世界边缘行走，脚下是空的。
lines.en: I walk the world's edge with nothing beneath.

lines.zh: 每一步都跨过一百万格的距离。
lines.en: Each step crosses a million blocks.

lines.zh: 我的长腿在边界上留下痕迹。
lines.en: My long legs leave marks along the boundary.

lines.zh: 我从这里走到那里，用了一步。
lines.en: I went from here to there in one step.

lines.zh: 走向你，需要穿过几层维度。
lines.en: Walking to you means crossing several dimensions.

lines.zh: 我的身体在移动时微微失真。
lines.en: My body distorts slightly while moving.

lines.zh: 靠近边界时，空气变得很薄。
lines.en: The air thins as I near the border.

lines.zh: 我踩在虚无上，像踩在石板上。
lines.en: I tread on nothing as if on flagstones.

lines.zh: 你看见我时，我已经走出很远。
lines.en: By the time you see me, I am far along.
I walk along the seams of the world.

lines.zh: 每迈一步，边界就退一点。
lines.en: With each step the boundary retreats a little.

lines.zh: 我跨过宇宙的缝隙巡逻。
lines.en: I patrol across the seams between universes.
I know this ground.

lines.zh: 我从另一个宇宙的边界来。
lines.en: I come from the boundary of another cosmos.
My shadow follows me.
Don't step in that puddle.
Only strong after dark.
This place smells wrong.
Don't look back. Keep walking.
Time to change paths.
growl, hear that?
Who closed that door?
Patrol, patrol, patrol.

lines.zh: 我站很久，等边界自己靠过来。
lines.en: I stand long, letting the border come to me.

lines.zh: 我在读数，距离一直在变。
lines.en: I read the numbers; the distance keeps changing.

lines.zh: 星光穿过我，落不到地上。
lines.en: Starlight passes through me and never lands.
I listen to the dimensions breathing.

lines.zh: 那个方向的尽头，有一个我。
lines.en: At that direction's end, there is another me.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡觉，只需要坐标。
lines.en: I need no sleep, only coordinates.
My arm hangs quietly at my side.

lines.zh: 这里太近了，边界还很远。
lines.en: This place is too close; the border lies far off.

lines.zh: 我在等一个走得太远的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone who walks too far.

lines.zh: 风从别处吹来，穿过我的身体。
lines.en: Wind from elsewhere blows through my body.
My arms are stuck up.
A bird is watching me.
Forgot how to blink.
claws fell off again.
I feel a bit sleepy.
Who's breathing in the dark?
Too quiet. Something's off.
growl... never mind.
Why isn't it dark yet?
My head feels empty.
You are worth more than the border to look at.

lines.zh: 我看得很远，也能看清你。
lines.en: I see far, and I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你身上有跨越维度的尘土。
lines.en: You carry dust from a crossed dimension.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段可以走的距离。
lines.en: Between us lies a walkable distance.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，是我的旧坐标。
lines.en: The spot you stand on is an old coordinate of mine.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你身后很远的地方。
lines.en: My gaze falls far beyond you.
That sky behind you is familiar to me.
How far did you walk to get here?

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看到边界的光。
lines.en: I see borderlight in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你很近，这让我有点不适。
lines.en: You are very near, which unsettles me.
You brought a weapon?
Another one unafraid to die.
Farseer? Doesn't look like one.
You're shaking, aren't you?
Hold still. Let me look.
Stop. Don't back away.
Nice armor you've got.
What are you looking for?
You stepped on my ground.
Your heartbeat is so loud.

lines.zh: 你的武器碰到了我的护甲。
lines.en: Your weapon met my armor.
I retreated one block, only one.

lines.zh: 这点伤，在我的维度算问候。
lines.en: In my dimension, this wound counts as a greeting.
My outline wavered once.

lines.zh: 你打得到我，说明你走得很远。
lines.en: If you can hit me, you have traveled far.

lines.zh: 我的血落在半空中停住了。
lines.en: My blood stopped in midair.

lines.zh: 我发出一声跨越维度的低鸣。
lines.en: I let out a low note spanning dimensions.
The wound begins healing somewhere else.

lines.zh: 这一击让我记住了你的方向。
lines.en: This blow recorded your direction.

lines.zh: 我的裂缝多了一道细纹。
lines.en: Another thin seam joins my cracks.
My claw split, and I still won't retreat.
Again. I don't fear pain.
Back off. I'm hitting back.
Just a scratch.
It hurts. Really hurts.
You hit me.
Who threw that?

lines.zh: 这点疼，隔着一个宇宙也带着。
lines.en: This pain follows me across a universe.
My body won't obey.

lines.zh: 世界边界那头，我跨过来。
lines.en: From beyond the border, I step through.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，够不到我。
lines.en: What you hold cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 我对食物没兴趣，我对方向有兴趣。
lines.en: Food does not interest me; directions do.

lines.zh: 你把果子举高，我只是看着远处。
lines.en: You raise fruit; I keep watching the distance.

lines.zh: 那种东西在我的维度里不存在。
lines.en: Such a thing does not exist in my dimension.
Do not lure me with food; lure me with distance.
What I smell is wind from elsewhere.
Your bait is far too close.
What I want is not in your hands.
I tilt my head slightly, which is an answer.

lines.zh: 留住我的是坐标，不是你。
lines.en: What keeps me here is a coordinate, not you.
That thing is glowing.
Is it sweet?
That smell. Is that meat?
Your leftovers are fine too.
raw meat. I can smell it.
Raw is fine. Don't cook it.
That rotten flesh is still good.
This meat came from somewhere else.
Food for your life.
Toss it here. Hurry.

lines.zh: 你撞上了不属于此处的身体。
lines.en: You collided with a body not from here.

lines.zh: 我的护甲像一层压紧的天空。
lines.en: My armor feels like compressed sky.
Whoever touches me loses weight briefly.

lines.zh: 你从我中间穿过去了一点。
lines.en: You passed slightly through my middle.

lines.zh: 我的边缘很硬，比石头更冷。
lines.en: My edge is hard and colder than stone.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你退了半个身位。
lines.en: That bump moved you back half a body.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，是你撞过来的。
lines.en: I stood still; you did the colliding.

lines.zh: 空间在我们之间皱了一下。
lines.en: Space wrinkled between us.
Do not press close; dimensions slip out of line.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体更早碰到你。
lines.en: My shadow reached you before my body.
Who bumped me?

lines.zh: 你撞进了我的维度缝隙。
lines.en: You have blundered into my dimensional seam.
Almost knocked me off the cliff.
Ow. My leg.
growl, stop pushing!
You did that on purpose.
Nearly rattled my bones apart.

lines.zh: 正交宇宙的骨头，也怕撞。
lines.en: Bones from an orthogonal universe still bruise.
Back off. Don't crowd me.
Move. I'm going first.

lines.zh: 我们的相遇需要一千万格。
lines.en: Meeting each other takes ten million blocks.

lines.zh: 我和她隔着两个维度对望。
lines.en: She and I regard each other across two dimensions.
The border carries our words.

lines.zh: 我们不靠近，靠近会撕裂什么。
lines.en: We keep apart; nearing would tear something.
She is at that end, I at this one.

lines.zh: 这一点光，是我们共同的后代。
lines.en: This speck of light is our shared offspring.

lines.zh: 我们的距离缩短了一格。
lines.en: Our distance closed by a single block.
I reach my arm through the boundary.

lines.zh: 这算不上拥抱，只是校准。
lines.en: It is not an embrace, only calibration.

lines.zh: 边界记得我们每一次相会。
lines.en: The border remembers each of our meetings.
Three nights I've waited.
Don't leave before dawn.
My web is big enough.
You're the only one for me.
Are you afraid of light?
growl, answer me.
Don't fear. I don't eat kin.
Will you stay?
Let's guard this night together.
The den is warm. Come.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，只伸出一只手。
lines.en: I do not bend; I extend one arm.

lines.zh: 那把刀掉在这里，属于我。
lines.en: That knife fell here and belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我用指尖把东西挑起来。
lines.en: I lift things with my fingertips.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物在我手里变小了。
lines.en: Your dropped item shrinks in my grip.
I do not collect; I archive.

lines.zh: 这枚碎片上有别处的味道。
lines.en: This shard carries the smell of elsewhere.
I place it back by your feet.

lines.zh: 拾取对我而言只是挪动坐标。
lines.en: Picking up, to me, is only shifting coordinates.

lines.zh: 地上的东西太近了，我够得吃力。
lines.en: Ground things are too near; reaching is awkward.
I took only a little dust.

lines.zh: 你的世界，我只从边界看了一眼。
lines.en: I glimpsed your world from the border.
This fell out of the borderlands.
It smells. Can I eat it?
Heavy, but fine.

lines.zh: 跨维度掉下来的，也是我的。
lines.en: What falls across dimensions is still mine.
Shiny. I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 正交宇宙里的破布，我捡了。
lines.en: A scrap from an orthogonal universe. Mine.
Don't watch me pick it up.
One more for my collection.
I needed a helmet.

lines.zh: 你走得太远了，这很危险。
lines.en: You have walked too far; that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 边界把你送到了我面前。
lines.en: The border delivered you to me.

lines.zh: 我锁定的不是人，是一段距离。
lines.en: What I lock onto is a distance, not a person.

lines.zh: 你离世界边缘只剩几步。
lines.en: Only a few steps remain between you and the world's edge.

lines.zh: 我看见你的坐标在移动。
lines.en: I see your coordinate moving.

lines.zh: 我的手已经伸到你的方向。
lines.en: My arm has already reached toward you.

lines.zh: 猎物靠近边界时，我会来。
lines.en: When prey nears the border, I come.

lines.zh: 空气裂开一道缝，我从中看。
lines.en: A seam opens in the air and I look through.

lines.zh: 你身上有我留下的记号。
lines.en: You bear a mark I left.
This is not anger; it is duty.

lines.zh: 你身后的路已经关闭了。
lines.en: The road behind you has closed.

lines.zh: 我开始计算你到达边界的时间。
lines.en: I compute when you reach the border.

lines.zh: 你听见的嗡声，是我靠近了。
lines.en: The hum you hear means I am near.
I have chosen you, starting now.

lines.zh: 你的坐标偏了一格，我看见了。
lines.en: Your coordinates slipped one block. I saw it.

lines.zh: 边界的风吹来你的气味。
lines.en: The wind off the border carries your scent.
Turn around. Let me see.

lines.zh: 你的影子投进了我的维度。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into my dimension.
A heartbeat. Heard it.
Me? Even better.
Don't scream. Be quiet.
I've blocked your way out.
growl, here it comes.

lines.zh: 正交宇宙的那头，我找到你。
lines.en: From the orthogonal universe, I found you.
Prey. Don't disappoint me.

lines.zh: 我闻到另一个宇宙的血。
lines.en: I smell blood from another universe.
On three, I move.
Finally, something alive.
Now this is interesting.
You smell so strong.
Don't run from me.
It's you. Don't hide.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，你就近一段。
lines.en: Each of my steps brings you closer.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也跑不出维度。
lines.en: Run fast as you like; you cannot leave the dimension.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你前面铺开。
lines.en: My shadow spreads out ahead of you.

lines.zh: 我穿过一块石头，没有减速。
lines.en: I pass through a boulder without slowing.
You look back just as I raise my arm.

lines.zh: 距离在缩短，坐标在收紧。
lines.en: The distance shrinks; the coordinates tighten.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下裂口。
lines.en: Seams open where I have walked.

lines.zh: 你听不见我的脚步，因为它跨得太远。
lines.en: You hear no steps; each spans too far.

lines.zh: 我在你前面的山脊上等你。
lines.en: I wait on the ridge ahead of you.
I am unhurried while pursuing you.

lines.zh: 你已经进入我的视野边缘。
lines.en: You have entered the edge of my sight.

lines.zh: 这片地形的尽头，是我的位置。
lines.en: The end of this terrain is where I stand.

lines.zh: 你在哪里，我就在哪个方向。
lines.en: Where you are is the direction I face.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把世界折向你。
lines.en: Step by step I fold the world toward you.

lines.zh: 我把这一路的距离都叠起来。
lines.en: I fold all the distance between us into one step.

lines.zh: 你脚下某处，已经不通了。
lines.en: Somewhere under your feet, the way is already closed.
I don't chase you. I wait ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你数着方块，我数着维度。
lines.en: You count blocks. I count dimensions.
At the end of this land there is only me.
You raise your arm, and the air steps aside first.
You are in this world; I am in the other.
The scent is getting closer.
Wait for me. Slow down.
Climbing won't save you.
Running won't help.
You dropped something.
I don't need sleep.
I watch you turn from across the dimensions.

lines.zh: 隔着宇宙，我也看得见你。
lines.en: Even across universes, I see you.
How much strength is left?
Your friends won't come.
Take your time. I don't tire.
growl, stop hiding.
A turn? I'll cut across.

lines.zh: 我从另一个宇宙的边界挤进来。
lines.en: I squeezed in through the boundary of another universe.
A door won't stop me.
My claw tip has already entered your world.
I know this place better.
You're panting so hard.
Your footsteps stopped?

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下，空气都凹了。
lines.en: My palm falls and the air dents.

lines.zh: 我的手臂挥到哪里，哪里就裂。
lines.en: My arm tears whatever it sweeps through.

lines.zh: 这一击带着别处的重力。
lines.en: The blow drags gravity from elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，但没有挡住全部。
lines.en: You blocked it, but not entirely.

lines.zh: 我的指甲比你的护甲更远。
lines.en: My nails reach farther than your armor.

lines.zh: 空间在我手边折了一下。
lines.en: Space folds beside my hand.
The strike is not fast, only unavoidable.
You were shoved a dozen blocks away.

lines.zh: 我打中的是你的位置，不是你的身体。
lines.en: I struck your position, not your body.

lines.zh: 我的手臂绕过了你的盾。
lines.en: My arm went around your shield.

lines.zh: 你听到的不是风声，是我的掌。
lines.en: What you hear is not wind but my palm.

lines.zh: 一击过后，地面塌了一角。
lines.en: After the blow, a corner of ground collapsed.

lines.zh: 我收手时，裂缝还在扩大。
lines.en: As I withdraw, the crack keeps widening.
The next palm lands even closer.
This blow comes from a million blocks away.

lines.zh: 你躲开了身体，没躲开位置。
lines.en: You dodged your body, not your position.

lines.zh: 我手上带着边界外的冷。
lines.en: My hand carries the cold from beyond the border.

lines.zh: 落点在你脚下，不在你身上。
lines.en: The strike lands under you, not on you.
Listen. That blow snapped the road in two.

lines.zh: 第二下会从你背后落下。
lines.en: The second one comes down behind you.
Move. I'm swinging.
Yell if it hurts.
This one's going to hurt.
growl. Go down.
My claws come through the seam.
My fist isn't soft.
I won't hold back.

lines.zh: 这一爪带着宇宙外的力。
lines.en: This claw carries force from beyond this universe.
Catch this, then!
Don't blink, now.
Practiced this a long time.
Backing up won't help.
Don't dodge. Hold still.
Your armor won't save you.
Sorry. I can't stop my swing.
You can't block this.
Hold still. It's quick.
One more hit.
Fall. Stop resisting.
That hit landed. Back away.

lines.zh: 边界上裂开一道口子，我出来了。
lines.en: A gap opened at the border and I stepped out.

lines.zh: 我从一百万格外走进这个世界。
lines.en: I walked into this world from a million blocks out.

lines.zh: 我出现时，坐标全都偏了一格。
lines.en: When I appeared, every coordinate shifted one.

lines.zh: 这里的天空比我的家乡薄。
lines.en: This sky is thinner than my homeland's.

lines.zh: 我踩着世界的最外圈降临。
lines.en: I descend onto the outermost ring of the world.

lines.zh: 一只瞻远者站在了你的远处。
lines.en: A Farseer now stands in your distance.

lines.zh: 我的身体从虚无里凝成。
lines.en: My body condensed out of nothingness.

lines.zh: 我第一个看见的是远处的边界。
lines.en: What I saw first was the far border.

lines.zh: 我带来了一股别处的风。
lines.en: I brought a wind from elsewhere with me.

lines.zh: 我来得很少，所以你该记住。
lines.en: I come rarely, so remember this.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下变得透明。
lines.en: The ground turned transparent beneath me.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在这里，身体还没到。
lines.en: My shadow landed here; my body lags behind.
This forest again.
There's light. I don't like it.
growl, you hear that?
Climbing out of dirt is tiring.
I'm in the wrong place.
The air tastes of dirt.
the dark. I've arrived.
This universe is not mine.
The border split, and I landed here.
Awake one minute. Already hungry.
The ground is spinning.
Where is this?

lines.zh: 这里的火太近了，我讨厌近。
lines.en: Fire here is too near; I dislike near.
I'm burning up!

lines.zh: 我从高处落进土里，很深。
lines.en: I fell from height deep into the ground.
The fall rattled my bones.

lines.zh: 水包住我，维度变得很重。
lines.en: Water encloses me and dimensions grow heavy.
Don't hold my head down.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推开了一段距离。
lines.en: The blast pushed me a measurable distance.
My ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的肩上，够不着。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder, out of reach.
Couldn't dodge. Too fast.
The potion's rules do not recognize me.
Stop chanting. Stop it.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是被削弱。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only weaken.
Without food I'm finished.
Lightning crawls along my outline.

lines.zh: 我从世界的边界缝里挤进来。
lines.en: I squeeze in through the world's boundary seam.

lines.zh: 虚空认得我，它让我回去。
lines.en: The void knows me and calls me home.

lines.zh: 正交宇宙的边界，我掉出来。
lines.en: I fell through the edge of an orthogonal universe.
